name: referrals
title: Invitations & Referrals
description: Personal invitation links for every user, with automatic sign-up tracking
notes: Each user gets a link like /register?ref=abcd2345 under Settings → Referrals (also shown on the dashboard).
The web app remembers ?ref= for 30 days, so sign-ups via password, social login or magic link are all credited.
Build rewards on top with `referrerOf(userId)` from src/modules/referrals.
